_comment: Score cutoffs for the PEDDEP graded CUT&RUN QC report: the ChIP-seq cutoffs, except read depth (CUT&RUN needs far fewer reads; ~5-10M pairs is typical). 'higher': value >= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (below the first cutoff = -2). 'status': FastQC-style pass = +2, warn = 0, fail = -2. NSC, RSC, FRiP, Total_Peaks and ROSE counts are not graded for Input/IgG controls. Metrics not listed are reported but not graded. Duplicates are kept in CUT&RUN targets, so NRF/PBC describe the library rather than what was used for peaks.
